name: Dark Achilles
description: A legendary hero fallen from grace, bound in gold-accented midnight armor. Dark Achilles balances catastrophic crushing power with an unyielding shield layer, shifting its tactical stance depending on the battlefield conditions.

ability.name: Fallen Knight
ability.description: Activating Dark Knight Strike triggers a corrupted stance shift. If Dark Achilles has more than 50% HP, it permanently gains +20 Attack for the rest of the phase. If below 50% HP, it generates a 40 HP dark barrier and increases defense counter damage by 15.

chain._note: high_hp_attack_buff: +20 ATK permanently if triggered while HP>50% (engine fires once)
low_hp_shield_value: 40 HP dark barrier below 50% HP
low_hp_counter_bonus: +15 counter damage approximated as dmg_amp

special_move.name: Dark Knight Strike
special_move.description: Sprints along the stadium ridge before descending into a punishing multi-angled shield bash and sword pierce combo.
flavour_texts: 🛡️ **Dark Knight Strike** — The corrupted shield absorbs the stadium's friction!
🗡️ **Second Strike** — An obsidian blade cleaves right through the center map!
